🔄 Content update (Published: July 30, 2026 / Previous: August 6, 2026)
Main change: A donation box has been newly added at Minami-Komane Welfare Center.

We are accepting donations for the 2026 Kumamoto earthquake disaster relief. A donation box is set up at the counter of the General Information Desk on the 1st floor of Hanno City Hall main building. Collection period: Friday, July 31, 2026 through Friday, October 23, 2026, weekdays 9:00 AM–4:30 PM. If you need a receipt, please contact the Community Welfare Division (Window 11) on the 1st floor of City Hall.

A donation box is also set up at Minami-Komane Welfare Center, which follows the center's regular opening days and hours.

If you prefer to transfer directly to the Japanese Red Cross Society, the collection period is Friday, July 31, 2026 through Friday, October 30, 2026. For Japan Post Bank / post offices: account symbol and number 00190-3-605956 (Japanese Red Cross 2026 Kumamoto Earthquake Relief). Transfers at post office counters are free of charge. For bank transfers:
• Sumitomo Mitsui Bank Suzuran Branch, Regular Savings 2787553
• Mitsubishi UFJ Bank Yamabiko Branch, Regular Savings 2105551
• Mizuho Bank Kunugi Branch, Regular Savings 0620820
Account name: Japanese Red Cross Society. 100% of donations go to disaster victims.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kenkohukusibu/chiikifukushika/14121.html
